about: What the public Mac release bundles from models/manifest.json (scripts/fetch_models.py bundle). A model not named here is bundled whole when required and left out when optional. Every rule says why.

arc-v1.note: Whissle's own model (CC BY-NC 4.0); Moonshine tiny inside is MIT. Licence + NOTICE ship in Resources/Licenses.

arctag.note: Whissle's own model (CC BY-NC 4.0 + Whissle terms).

index-data.note: Only the Wikipedia leads (CC BY-SA 4.0). The local-moments index (arc/, audio/, docs.jsonl, vectors.npz) is built from third-party recordings that are not ours to redistribute, so the release has no local-moments search.

demo-audio.note: Only the Replay questions voiced with Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0). Questions voiced with macOS system voices (licensed for personal, non-commercial use) and the local-moments questions are left out.
